name: Wing Tai Holdings Limited
summary: Wing Tai Holdings Limited (the Company) is listed on the Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited. Together with its subsidiaries (the Group), its core businesses are in property development and investment, lifestyle retail and hospitality management. Wing Tai embraces a corporate philosophy centered on building strong partnerships and delivering enduring value and quality through its property and retail businesses. The Group's growth is guided by its core values of Integrity, Teamwork, Leadership, Passion and Continuous Improvement.
